# Traefik — custom-context-push-url

custom-context with VAADIN_PUSH_URL=/VAADIN/push. The relocated URL resolves against the context, so the browser asks for /app/VAADIN/push and the existing router already covers it.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/app/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Traefik dynamic config (`vaadin.yml`), mounted into
`/etc/traefik/dynamic`:

```yaml
# custom-context with VAADIN_PUSH_URL=/VAADIN/push.
#
# Identical to custom-context/vaadin.yml. The relocated push URL is resolved
# against the context, so the browser asks for /app/VAADIN/push and the router
# below already covers it; and Traefik needs no upgrade rule in the first
# place. The Apache and NGINX siblings each add a block for this endpoint.
http:
  routers:
    vaadin:
      # Two clauses, not a bare PathPrefix(`/app`). Traefik's PathPrefix is a
      # raw string prefix, so the bare form also matches /application. Every
      # context-prefix rule in this tree is written this way.
      rule: PathPrefix(`/app/`) || Path(`/app`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      middlewares:
        - compress
      service: vaadin

  services:
    vaadin:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: http://vaadin:8080

  middlewares:
    compress:
      compress:
        excludedContentTypes:
          - text/event-stream
          - text/plain
```

The entryPoints and the file provider come from the shared
[traefik.yml](../../traefik.yml), mounted read-only.
